aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari; Lord, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari. You have fulfilled the wishes of your devotees.
aarti.pad1: A garland of flowers is round your neck, and you wear a crown on your head; you are clad in yellow, in the pītāmbara, and earrings hang in your ears. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You shine on a jewelled throne; your servants and devotees stand in attendance. They cast incense on the fire, and the lamp's flame burns. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Golden plates are filled with modakas, kheer and cūrmā; your servants offer them to you, and a whisk is waved above your head. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Cymbals, kettledrums and gongs, conches and the mṛdaṅga resound; devotees sing the āratī and raise cries of victory. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Whoever meditates gains the fruit and is freed from every sorrow, when the servant utters with his own lips: Śrī Śyāma, Śyāma. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Śyāma Bihārījī — Dāsa Manohara sings it — gains the fruit the heart desires. ॥6॥
